plan.summary: Uploads in `uploadAll` now run at most four at a time. The change adds the `p-limit` dependency and wraps each `putObject` call in a `pLimit(4)` limiter. Before, `Promise.all` started every upload at once.
plan.riskRationale: Small change in one function. It adds one dependency. It lowers concurrency and keeps the same results. The change has no tests in the diff.
plan.storyArc: The change adds p-limit, then uses it in uploadAll to cap concurrent uploads at four.

topics.title: Cap concurrent uploads at four with p-limit
topics.narrativeBrief: How does uploadAll now limit concurrency, and what does the new dependency provide? Verify that Promise.all still waits for all uploads and that errors still propagate as before.
